description:
Brand Introduction:

Koolmi.com is a fashion-forward, e-commerce platform offering a wide range of stylish and comfortable apparel for men, women, and children. We specialize in unique, high-quality prints and designs, including our popular print-on-demand t-shirts and sweatshirts. Our mission is to provide our customers with trendy fashion that complements their lifestyle, from casual wear to statement pieces.

Product Description: 

At Koolmi, we offer a variety of premium products, including sweatshirts, t-shirts, and accessories. Each item is designed with creativity and passion, featuring custom designs like "Do Not Disturb I'm Gaming," "Think Positive Get Positive," and more. Our print-on-demand service ensures that each product is made to order with care, ensuring the highest quality and personalized experience for every customer.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

Koolmi's unique selling point is our high-quality, customizable, and trendy fashion apparel. We cater to different tastes with our print-on-demand offerings, ensuring every customer can find something that matches their style. Additionally, we focus on sustainability and comfort, making our products perfect for casual wear or as gifts for special occasions.

Payment Terms: 

We offer affiliates a competitive commission structure based on the sales they generate. Commissions are paid on a monthly basis through PayPal or bank transfer. For more details on payment terms, please refer to the affiliate program guidelines available on UpPromote.

Other Information:

- We offer dedicated support for affiliates to help them maximize their earnings.
- Our products are designed with attention to detail, ensuring customer satisfaction.
- Affiliates will have access to banners, product links, and other promotional materials to help them succeed.
